$comment: Every site the experience will fetch. The Worker in experience/src/worker.js enforces `host` (exact match or any subdomain) and, when `paths` is present, only URLs under one of those path prefixes. Entries that also carry `id`, `label` and `start` are the apps listed on /dashboard/experience; the rest are dependencies, enforced but not shown. Edit here, then redeploy both: `npm run deploy` in experience/ and the app.
